753b4fda6c27137e.reason: yindex serve listens in-cluster only (ClusterIP Service); TLS is terminated at the Envoy Gateway, which routes the three CompactTxStreamer methods to it (templates/gateway/routes.yaml). It serves public chain data and holds no secret.

e9346748462ab93f.reason: The kind-only RPC password of the testnet chart's local render (rpc.password, a laptop cluster with no keys and RPC reachable only in-cluster): a default credential, not a secret, as the rule's own exclusion of charts/ycash-lightwallet/values-kind.yaml (AGENTS.md rule 7). EKS reads it through External Secrets (values-eks.yaml rpc.existingSecret).

ba2071e94710b231.reason: The ycashd-rpc secret (the node's rpcuser/rpcpassword, AGENTS.md rule 4) is encrypted at rest with the account's AWS-managed aws/secretsmanager key; a customer-managed KMS key adds cost and a key policy for one testnet credential (the resource's own #checkov:skip=CKV_AWS_149). Carries over the accepted entry for infra/eks/secrets.tf, which moved into the module. Revisit if the account requires CMKs.

9512e3888c6f9dd0.reason: The yindex-postgres URL secret, as the ycashd-rpc one above: AWS-managed aws/secretsmanager key; the database holds only a derived index of public chain data.

e3d6a74a4d05859e.reason: Not a credential: cluster_certificate_authority_data = "ZXhhbXBsZQ==" is base64 of the word `example`, a mocked output of override_module in a terraform test (beside cluster_endpoint https://example.invalid and an all-zero account id).

c17f0e0dc33e3028.reason: fetch() is only reached with https URLs: main() rejects a --url that is not https://, and every followed link passes same_site() (scheme https, the explorer's own domain); urllib's redirect handler follows only http/https/ftp, so file:// cannot be reached. It runs once on the one-shot harvest instance (infra/mainnet-harvest/files/harvest-run.sh step 5), reads public pages and writes only host:port lines whose addresses pass ipaddress.is_global.

bdf39432a9b33a17.reason: rpc() posts to the node URLs of the NODES environment variable, which the chart writes from its own node Services (charts/ycash-testnet/templates/status.yaml); no request input reaches the URL (the probe's HTTP handler only serves /metrics, /status.json, /healthz).

db01587d587ffb25.reason: BUNDLE_MANIFEST_URL is operator configuration (chart value probe.bundleManifestUrl, rendered into the Deployment's env in templates/status.yaml); no request input reaches it.

a86156dddb14e6b8.reason: PROBE_URL is fixed by the chart to the in-cluster probe Service (http://<release>-probe:9100/status.json, templates/status.yaml); the status page's handler serves a fixed set of paths and never puts request input into a URL.

f929053e49478689.reason: Deliberate: the one-shot harvest instance needs an outbound address to reach Ycash peers, the explorer, package mirrors and S3, and a public IPv4 is cheaper than a NAT gateway. Nothing is inbound: the instance's security group has no ingress rule, the VPC's default security group is closed, the shell is SSM Session Manager and IMDSv2 is required (main.tf metadata_options); the VPC holds only this instance (the resource's own #checkov:skip=CKV_AWS_130).

rule_paths.reason: Operator scripts run by hand on a developer machine against a kind cluster (kubectl/ycash-cli with argv lists, no shell, arguments from the script's own config).
Operator scripts run by hand against a kind cluster; the URL is the node RPC endpoint from the script's own config, never untrusted input.

contrib/secops/code-scanning-triage.py runs `gh api` with an argv list (no shell) built from constants, the alert number from the API and the workflow-supplied repository name; it runs only in .github/workflows/code-scanning.yml with that job's own token. A subprocess call anywhere else is still reported.

bundles/prefix/tests/fake_docker.py is the test double for `docker` in the run-local.sh tests: it starts sys.executable -I with argv lists (no shell) on this repository's own test scripts and harvest.py, with arguments from run-local.sh under test. It runs only inside `make prefix-test`, never in a deployment. A subprocess call anywhere else is still reported.
